pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Cabin on your own computer in one line, confirm yourself as the owner and open the app.

pages.title: Homes and people
pages.summary: Add each home with its owner and commission, then give managers and cleaners their own access.

pages.title: Deploy your own Cabin
pages.summary: Configure required private inputs, mail and optional integrations in your own Cloudflare account.

pages.title: Put Cabin online
pages.summary: Review shared hosting options, or follow Cabin’s separate guide to deploy in your own account.

pages.title: Channel calendars
pages.summary: Connect each home's Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com calendar links, publish Cabin's own links back, read the calendar grid and take requests without double bookings.

pages.title: Direct bookings
pages.summary: Publish each home's booking page, set stay rules and taxes, collect Stripe test payments, and retain signed agreements, ID checks and damage holds.

pages.title: Guest inbox
pages.summary: One thread per guest across stays, email and texts; check-in details, checkout reminders and review requests on time; drafted replies that wait for your nod.

pages.title: Turnovers
pages.summary: Every stay makes its turnover and door codes; the cleaner is emailed, marks the home ready with photos, and Readiness shows which homes are ready.

pages.title: Owner statements
pages.summary: Import channel payout CSVs, match stays, review management fees and owner payout, approve and deliver frozen statements, and export to Pantry or QuickBooks.

pages.title: Financial exception cases
pages.summary: Investigate split settlements, missing fees and refunds, review source-linked corrections and keep unresolved owner distributions visible.

pages.title: Portfolio questions
pages.summary: Ask scoped questions about owner net, arrivals, reservations and saved conversations, follow their sources and approve assigned investigations.

pages.title: Agent access
pages.summary: Give the agent you already use a token to prepare calendar reviews, turnovers and statements for a person to approve.

pages.title: Move in your homes
pages.summary: Upload Guesty, Hostaway or OwnerRez exports, review records and refusals, reconcile totals and sign off or undo.

pages.title: Provider export formats
pages.summary: Documented provider CSV columns, missing export data and the supplementary cutover file.

pages.title: Back up, restore and erase
pages.summary: Export the whole installation to one archive, restore it into a fresh copy, and erase a home for good.

pages.title: Erasure and retention
pages.summary: Review and erase personal data, inspect legal holds and receipts, and prevent erased contacts being reused.

pages.title: Management allocations
pages.summary: Allocate source-backed receipts, shared invoices, reserves and multiple owner interests under frozen agreements.

pages.title: Portable records
pages.summary: Inspect the archive schema, retained evidence, excluded credentials and review steps before restarting restored work.

pages.title: Command reference
pages.summary: Every command the app and the agent door accept, with its input and who may run it.
